title: Agentic Search for Context Engineering — Leonie Monigatti, Elastic
talk_summary: Leonie Monigatti argues context engineering is mostly agentic search: agents choose among specialized and general search tools, and tool/skill design determines success. She demonstrates failure modes like wrong tool choice, bad parameters, and zero results, then fixes them with descriptive tool contracts, progressive-disclosure skills, error returns, shell/file-system search, and hybrid verification.

takeaways.technique: Tool contracts with trigger conditions and relationships
takeaways.what_they_do: Write tool descriptions that state core purpose, when to use/not use the tool, and prerequisite relationships such as loading a skill before calling a general query tool; reinforce the same rule in the system prompt.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you add more parameters or more tools and your agent is starting to struggle with calling the right uh tool, then maybe add some trigger condition

takeaways.what_they_do: Keep only skill names/descriptions in context, load the full skill body on demand, and require the skill before a complex general-purpose tool is used.
takeaways.evidence_quote: always use elastic the elastic search ESQL skill to generate the ESQL query before using this tool

takeaways.technique: Log tool-call behavior, then add specialized tools
takeaways.what_they_do: Start with general-purpose tools, log agent behavior, and if agents need too many tool calls per question, build a narrower specialized tool for the recurring pattern.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you notice, maybe your agent is taking four or five tool calls per question. That's too many tool calls.
takeaways.numbers: 4-5 tool calls per question flagged as too many

takeaways.what_they_do: Use a structured database/search tool first, then verify results with a shell/file-search tool; the cited Vercel experiment found the hybrid agent most accurate.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the hybrid agent with the bash tool and the um database tool was actually achieving the highest um like highest accuracy

takeaways.technique: Return structured errors and zero-result semantics for self-correction
takeaways.what_they_do: Wrap tools in error handling and return the error response to the agent so it can rewrite the query; explicitly decide whether zero results is valid or a failure mode.
takeaways.evidence_quote: I return the error response to the agent so it can kind of self-correct, rewrite the query.

takeaways.technique: Offload context to file store and reload on demand
takeaways.what_they_do: Keep paths/summaries in context, write long tool outputs and skills to the file store, load them only when needed, and offload/compact after the context moves on.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we're loading into the context window when we need that skill and then we offload it
